notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.99

• Lock app: in Settings › Apps › an app, turn on "Lock app" and it opens only with your fingerprint or face, however it's opened. It stays open while you use it and locks again 30 seconds after you leave it or when the screen goes off.
• DuckAI installs apps: "Install Spotify" / "Installiere Spotify" / "Spotify'ı yükle". You say yes, and DuckStore downloads and installs it by itself.
• DuckAI's questions (send, call, install) look like DuckOS.
• DuckWallet: member cards and gift cards can be edited (Edit card).
• Apps that ask for a photo get DuckOS's own picker instead of Android's.
• Camera: photos use the sensor's clean 12 MP mode (sharper, less noise). Pro mode keeps the full 50 MP.
• Settings › Apps › an app opens without freezing.
